title: Static Burst
blurb: A half-second burst of pink-noise static — the sound of a radio losing signal or a speaker giving up. Editors use it as a glitch transition; pranksters play it mid-conversation to convince someone their headphones are dying. It cuts through any audio mix instantly, which is exactly why it works. Original generated noise, free to download and use anywhere.
origin: Generated pink-noise burst, shaped like an analog radio dropout.
